name: Hotel Greil
beschreibung: Hotel Greil is located in the heart of Söll within the renowned Wilder Kaiser holiday region. The hotel combines authentic Tyrolean style with attentive family hospitality. Guests enjoy immediate access to the extensive slopes of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental and a dense network of summer hiking trails. Facilities include a revitalising wellness area with sauna and steam room, country-style rooms, and a restaurant serving acclaimed gourmet regional cuisine.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Greil in Söll in the Wilder Kaiser region provides family-run 4-star comfort, a sauna and steam wellness area, gourmet dining, and direct access to SkiWelt.
